template.caption: One or two sentences about the shot.

workflow: Add 6 to 8 strong images under assets/img/photography/ for the first public batch.
Duplicate the template entry for each image and keep collection set to Selected Work.
Write plain-language alt text and a one- to two-sentence caption for every image.
Use year and optional location so each card has enough context without becoming technical.
emptyText: The portfolio page is wired up and ready. Add image files under assets/img/photography/, duplicate the template entry, and list them in this file to publish work here.
